purpose: Track whether the active God Mode and Command Center objective has real feature or governance improvement evidence across every required topic before completion is claimed.

topics.newImprovement: SEIS Command Center now exposes a feature growth ledger inside God Mode while the demo dashboard continues to surface completion audit, run state, handoff, staging, changelog, module coverage, and ecosystem lanes.
topics.remainingGap: Rendered screenshot, push, CI, and final staged-boundary evidence are still required before completion is claimed.

topics.newImprovement: Goals now have governance evidence that requires acceptance evidence, validation duty, rollback posture, and visible completion gaps.
topics.remainingGap: Final commit boundary and CI evidence are still missing.

topics.newImprovement: Repository health remains visible through publish safety, plugin posture, CI posture, and protected work boundaries.
topics.remainingGap: Branch integration, push, CI, and protected local work review must stay isolated during integration.

topics.newImprovement: Documentation now connects governance index evidence with the Command Center README, architecture model, and feature growth ledger governance doc.
topics.remainingGap: Generated reports and governance docs must remain current after final staging.

topics.newImprovement: Agent lanes stay accountable for God Mode Developer, Focus Mode, Master Prompt, Security Review, GitHub Workflow, and handoff visibility.
topics.remainingGap: Provider-backed agent execution still requires secure credential flow, external validation, and CI evidence.

topics.newImprovement: Security remains represented through enterprise gates, release readiness, SSH/cloud safety contracts, no-secret policy constraints, and Command Center-visible blockers.
topics.remainingGap: External Code Scanning, protected-branch enforcement, and CI security evidence are still missing.

topics.newImprovement: AI policy remains visible through intent, risk, owner, audit, rollback, policy version, provider lane, and approval markers.
topics.remainingGap: Live provider adapters need least-privilege credential setup, audit evidence, and external validation before activation.

topics.newImprovement: Rollback stays attached to enterprise gates, the work package, release readiness, automation evidence, and visible completion blockers.
topics.remainingGap: Rollback proof should cite the final pushed commit or explicit handoff boundary.

topics.newImprovement: Validation now has a plan, local validation log, UI evidence, a dedicated feature growth check, and static app tests for the ledger surface.
topics.remainingGap: CI evidence is still required before completion.

topics.newImprovement: Handoff records changed surfaces, validation status, risks, rollback, next commands, protected user work, staging review posture, and Command Center-visible blockers.
topics.remainingGap: Handoff remains open until commit hash, push result, and CI pass evidence exist.

completionBlockers: No commit hash exists for the full reviewed package.
completionRule: The broad God Mode objective remains not-complete until every required topic has improvement evidence, required gates pass, unrelated user work is protected, and commit/push/CI or explicit handoff evidence exists.
